notes: New mod: Timeless and Classics Guns: Zero (Mods > Featured - off until you turn it on; it downloads a 6 MB gun pack the first time). 54 real guns - pistols, SMGs, rifles, snipers, shotguns, machine guns and launchers - each with the original's models, reloads, inspects, draw and bolt animations, recoil and sounds.

Left click fires, right click aims down the sights, R reloads, I inspects, Y changes fire mode (auto, semi, burst). Make guns and ammo at any smithing table - right click it for the Gun Smith Table (shift + right click for smithing).
Works in singleplayer and on servers with the HybridGuns plugin. TaCZ's gun pack is by Serene Wave Studio / Timeless Squad (CC BY-NC-ND 4.0); this client draws and fires the guns with its own code.
